newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down 14 cents to 14.05 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down 14 cents to 14.05 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell 14 cents to 14.05 ringgit ($5.60) a kg, in response to an overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The market had little buying suppport, and just followed the LME," said a trader. The LME fell $65 on Wednesday.
Buyers were from Europe and Malaysia.
Initial offers totalled 153 tonnes against bids of 25. Turnover was 108 tonnes from 90 on Wednesday.
The local premium against the LME widened to $60 a tonne from $50 previously.
